correctness.rationale: Exact integral M^13=I+3B, all three initial roots and the three unit slopes are integer-verified. For j≥2, 3^j/j! times polynomial differences is in 9(a-b)Z3. Thus g_r=f_r/3 is an isometry and a mod-3 affine bijection; it has a unique 3-adic zero and all asserted valuations follow. The six residue classes, minimal periods (no q/3 or q/13 period), densities and uniform discrepancy are then proved. Finite 125000-term checks are supporting checks, not replacements.

value.rationale: Exact levels and least periods of a naturally shifted canonical third-order recurrence at the small prime three are a meaningful complete structure theorem. The three 3-adic root branches and geometric density law cover every nonnegative index and valuation, extending beyond the literature on unshifted Tribonacci or the shifted prime-47 case; not a finite isolated congruence.
